data.raw_text:
Isinagawa nitong Lunes ang dry run para sa bagong parking regulations sa Tomas Morato at Timog Avenue. 🚗

Sa tulong ng QC Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), maiiwasan na ang paniningil ng mga hindi otorisadong indibidwal o tinatawag na “parking boys.” 🚫

Layunin ng programang ito na mapanatili ang kaayusan at patas na paggamit ng mga pampublikong parking space para sa lahat ng motorista. 

Paalala rin sa publiko na sundin ang itinakdang oras ng parking at iba pang alituntunin upang maiwasan ang paglabag sa kalsada. 🙅‍♂️

As QCitizens, maging maalam at makiisa.
data.cleaned_text: Isinagawa nitong Lunes ang dry run para sa bagong parking regulations sa Tomas Morato at Timog Avenue. 🚗 Sa tulong ng QC Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), maiiwasan na ang paniningil ng mga hindi otorisadong indibidwal o tinatawag na “parking boys.” 🚫 Layunin ng programang ito na mapanatili ang kaayusan at patas na paggamit ng mga pampublikong parking space para sa lahat ng motorista. Paalala rin sa publiko na sundin ang itinakdang oras ng parking at iba pang alituntunin upang maiwasan ang paglabag sa kalsada. 🙅‍♂️ As QCitizens, maging maalam at makiisa.

SB19: P-Pop Kings Redefining Global Style

Photo Credits: 1Z Entertainment + Billboard Philippines + Mega Magazine + ITM. + VMan Southeast Asia

Origins: Forged in Fire

SB19 in school uniforms with umbrellas on grassy lawn 

In 2016, five young talents—Pablo Nase (leader), Josh Cullen Santos, Justin de Dios, Ken Suson, and Stell Ajero—entered a grueling survival show inspired by South Korean training camps. They endured physical drills, vocal bootcamps, and personality shaping under ShowBT Philippines, debuting as SB19 on October 26, 2018, with the heartfelt ballad "Tilaluha."

The early days were rocky. P-pop was nascent in the Philippines, and their debut barely registered amid K-pop's dominance. Yet, persistence fueled their spark—by 2019, explosive single "Go Up" ignited a movement, winning Song of the Year at the MYX Music Awards.
SB19 channels effortless charm on MEGA Magazine's cover, blending schoolboy whimsy with high-fashion edge.
